metadata.name: LED Badges
metadata.description: A loose pile of 3D LED name badges in gunmetal bezels, each scrolling its own neon dot-matrix marquee while winking smileys glow. Move the pointer to tilt the pile, click to flash every LED.
metadata.author: louisstudios
